searchText: MSRP $133,253. New 2026 Entegra Odyssey SE 22EF Luxury Class C RV. The Odyssey SE features the Ford® V8, Catalytic converter theft deterrent system and tire pressure monitoring system. You will also love the Entegra Coach Odyssey SE’s large sleeping capacity featuring a queen bed, heated holding tanks, 4KW generator, one-piece, seamless, fiberglass front cap, aluminum running boards, ball-bearing drawer guides, stainless teel kitchen sink and overhead loft with 750 lb. capacity. This RV comes with the optional 200W Solar panel w/ 2nd house battery, Auto leveling jacks and Customer Value Package featuring an LED TV, refrigerator with controls, backup camera and monitor, power patio awning, one-piece seamless fiberglass front cap, and the tank heating pads.
